channel._instruction: Add the relevant access channel indicating where access takes place (physical, virtual, or hybrid).

eligibility._instruction: Add the relevant access eligibility type indicating who is allowed to access (open, controlled, or restricted).

form._instruction: Add the relevant access form indicating whether the user interacts directly or through mediation.

process._instruction: Add the relevant access process type indicating how access is granted (immediate, registered, authenticated, provider-approved, or committee-approved).

paymentModel._instruction: Add all relevant payment model types indicating how access costs are determined. If no payment is requires, select zero-cost payment model.
